timeline.event: Incorporated (promoted by the Sanofi/Hoechst group; amidase enzyme unit)
Loss-making unit taken over by Sudhir Vaid; Unit I (Dholka) API operations
Quadria Capital (through Helix Investment Holdings) buys 20% for ~Rs475 cr; formulations plant (Valthera) starts
Unit III API plant at Limbasi commissioned (800 m3 of the 1,250 m3 fermentation capacity)
Share split Rs10 to Rs1 and a 1:10 bonus (95.1 lakh shares)
IPO listing: 100% offer for sale by Helix (2.09 cr shares at Rs741, Rs1,550.5 cr, 17.6x subscribed; anchors Rs465 cr); Quadria exits fully; listed at Rs943 (+27%)
26% of Clean Max Everglades (captive solar power, Rs6.1 cr); Palvella Therapeutics shares bought (FY25)
Stellon Biotech Inc. (US, 75%) and Concord Lifegen Ltd (India, 100%) set up
Celliimune Biotech Pvt Ltd (cell and gene therapy start-up, Rs66 lakh) becomes a wholly owned subsidiary
Board approves a 1:1 bonus (first since listing) and raises authorised capital to Rs22 cr, subject to shareholder approval

Palvella shares are fair-valued through OCI (FY26 OCI Rs55.2 cr), so the gain never reaches the P&L
Inventory rose to Rs326 cr (485 days of material cost on Screener) as customers staggered orders; WIP is held one step before completion until an order arrives (ICRA)
Government incentives (Rs7.9 cr a year) run through other income
